title: Kinematic signatures of impairment: Detecting alcohol intoxication in e-scooter riders using sensor data and machine learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.38276v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Alcohol intoxication is a leading contributor to fatal and severe-injured e-scooterist crashes. Current countermeasures, such as temporal restrictions or pre-ride cognitive screening, cannot continuously assess an e-scooterist's physical motor control or impairment in real time. We conducted a controlled experiment in which 25 participants rode an instrumented e-scooter through a test track while sober and at two targeted blood alcohol concentration levels (0.05% and 0.08%). The e-scooter was instrumented with a six-axis inertial measurement unit (IMU), and throttle and brake lever position sensors, all sampled at 100 Hz. Two complementary signal features were computed: normalised permutation entropy, which quantifies temporal complexity, and standard deviation, which quantifies signal amplitude. translated_title: 损伤的运动学特征：利用传感器数据和机器学习检测电动滑板车骑行者的酒精中毒状态
translated_abstract: 酒精中毒是导致电动滑板车骑行者发生致命及重伤事故的主要因素之一。目前的应对措施，例如时间限制或骑行前认知筛查，无法实时持续评估电动滑板车骑行者的身体运动控制能力或受损状态。我们开展了一项对照实验，25名参与者在清醒状态下以及达到两个目标血液酒精浓度水平（0.05%和0.08%）时，骑行一辆装有传感器的电动滑板车通过测试跑道。该电动滑板车配备了六轴惯性测量单元（IMU）以及油门和刹车杆位置传感器，所有信号均以100 Hz的频率采样。研究计算了两种互补的信号特征：归一化排列熵（用于量化时间复杂度）和标准差（用于量化信号幅度）。重复测量相关分析识别出七个运动学特征（均来自IMU和油门信号），其熵值显著降低（p < 0.001），而标准差……
tldr: 该研究通过在电动滑板车上部署六轴IMU及油门/刹车传感器，发现酒精中毒会使骑行运动信号的排列熵显著降低，从而实现基于传感器数据和机器学习的骑行者醉酒状态实时检测。
en_tdlr: This study demonstrates that alcohol intoxication significantly reduces permutation entropy in e-scooter riders' kinematic signals captured by onboard IMU and lever sensors, enabling real-time machine-learning-based detection of rider impairment.
